content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee.

rows.details: Institute of Advanced Study in Science and Technology (IASST), Guwahati
30 days from the date of the advertisement; about 18 December 2026 (30 days from 18 November 2026)

content_sections.heading: About IASST
content_sections.text: IASST is an autonomous institute under the Department of Science and Technology, Govt. of India, located at Paschim Boragaon, Garchuk, Guwahati-781035, Assam. The notice says research and development facilities exist in all its departments, that it has a well-stocked library, and that consultancy by faculty is encouraged. Two technology business incubators hosted by the Institute, BioNest-IASST and ISVEC, promote technology-based entrepreneurship by faculty.

content_sections.heading: Department-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice invites applications for three faculty posts, each with one vacancy. It does not name a department for any of them. The total is 3 (1 + 1 + 1).

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The notice counts post-doctoral experience from the date of awarding the Ph.D. degree certificate (provisional). The upper age limit is 50 years for all three posts. Age is counted as on the closing date for receiving applications. Age relaxation for candidates belonging to SC/ST/OBC/EWS/other categories is as per Government of India rules/orders on the subject. For the discipline-specific eligibility of each post, candidates should check the official notification.

rows.qualification: Master's degree in Bioinformatics/any areas of Life-Sciences with first class or equivalent (in terms of Grades or marks) at the master degree and excellent academic record throughout; and Ph.D. Degree in Bioinformatics or in any thrust research areas in Life Sciences at IASST.
rows.experience: Ten-year post-Ph.D., of which at least five years at the level of Assistant Professor-II/Scientist-C level (7th CPC Pay level 11) or equivalent, with excellent research record as evidenced by patents and/or publications in peer-reviewed journals. Desirable (not essential): at least one student awarded Ph.D. under the candidate's principal guide-ship.

rows.qualification: Master's degree in any areas of Life Sciences with first class or equivalent (in terms of Grades or marks) at the master degree and excellent academic record throughout; and Ph.D. in any area of Life Sciences with excellent research record as evidenced by patents and/or publications in peer-reviewed journals.
rows.experience: Ten years post-Ph.D., of which at least five years at the level of Assistant Professor-II/Scientist-C level (7th CPC Pay level 11) or equivalent, with excellent research record as evidenced by patents and/or publications in peer-reviewed journals. Desirable (not essential): at least one student awarded Ph.D. under the candidate's principal guide-ship.

rows.qualification: Master's degree in any areas of Life Sciences or Pharmacy/Pharmacology with first class or equivalent (in terms of Grades or marks) at the master degree and excellent academic record throughout; and Ph.D. in any area of Life Sciences/Pharmacy/Pharmacology/Pharmaceuticals.
rows.experience: Ten years post-Ph.D., of which at least five years at the level of Assistant Professor-II/Scientist-C level (7th CPC Pay level 11) or equivalent, with excellent research record as evidenced by patents and/or publications in peer-reviewed journals. Desirable (not essential): at least one student awarded Ph.D. under the candidate's principal guide-ship.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: Pay: Level 13 (Rs. 118500 - Rs. 214100) for all three posts. Pay protection is admissible as per rule. Allowances are as admissible to Central Government employees. The notice does not mention the contract term or tenure.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for IASST Associate Professor-II
content_sections.text: Three letters of recommendation, one preferably from the Ph.D. supervisor, to be submitted confidentially to the Director of the Institute at [email protected] . A summary note (maximum 1000 words) on the research work published after completing the Ph.D., highlighting completed projects, papers, IPR/patents, technology generated/commercialized, infrastructure development, programme/project framing, fund mobilization, and research and teaching activities and linkages. A research programme and work plan (maximum 2000 words) on the area the candidate would like to pursue in the position. The notice suggests consulting the Institute's website and annual reports while preparing it. Details of academic accomplishments: certificates, testimonials, awards/honours/research achievements and citation index of publications. No Objection Certificate, for persons employed in Government/Semi-Government organizations or educational institutions. If many applications are received, the Institute may restrict the number of candidates called for interview, based on qualifications/experience higher than the minimum, after screening by a duly constituted committee. The list of candidates short-listed and not short-listed for personal interviews will be notified on the Institute website. The notice does not give an interview date or venue.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Three letters of recommendation (one preferably from the Ph.D. supervisor). Summary note of post-Ph.D. research work (maximum 1000 words). Research programme and work plan (maximum 2000 words). Details of academic accomplishments, including the citation index of publications. No Objection Certificate, where the candidate is employed in a Government/Semi-Government organization or educational institution.

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in IASST Associate Professor-II recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 3 vacancies for Associate Professor-II: 1 OBC-NCL, 1 UR and 1 EWS.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for IASST Associate Professor-II?
faq.answer: The last date for the online application is 30 days from the date of the advertisement, 18 November 2026, which is about 18 December 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for IASST Associate Professor-II?
faq.answer: A Master's degree in Bioinformatics/Life Sciences (for the EWS post, Life Sciences or Pharmacy/Pharmacology) with first class or equivalent and an excellent academic record, plus a Ph.D. in the area given for the post. The exact wording for each post is in the qualification table above.

faq.question: Q4. How much experience is required?
faq.answer: Ten years post-Ph.D., of which at least five years at Assistant Professor-II/Scientist-C level (7th CPC Pay level 11) or equivalent. Having at least one student awarded a Ph.D. under the candidate's principal guide-ship is desirable, not essential.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for IASST Associate Professor-II?
faq.answer: The upper age limit is 50 years, counted as on the closing date for receiving applications. Relaxation for SC/ST/OBC/EWS/other categories is as per Government of India rules/orders.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of IASST Associate Professor-II?
faq.answer: The pay is Level 13 (Rs. 118500 - Rs. 214100). Allowances are as admissible to Central Government employees, and pay protection is admissible as per rule.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for IASST Associate Professor-II?
faq.answer: Apply online through the application link given in the notice. Three letters of recommendation must be sent confidentially to the Director at [email protected].

faq.question: Q8. How are candidates selected?
faq.answer: Shortlisted candidates are called for a personal interview. If many applications are received, a duly constituted committee may first screen them. The shortlist will be notified on the Institute website.

faq.question: Q9. Can PIO and OCI candidates apply?
faq.answer: Yes, the notice invites applications from Indian nationals including PIOs and OCIs. If a PIO or OCI is selected, permission will be sought from the Government of India before the candidate can join.

faq.question: Q10. Do government employees need a No Objection Certificate?
faq.answer: Yes. Employees of Government/Semi-Government organizations or educational institutions must apply through proper channels. An advance application may be submitted, but the NOC must reach within 15 days of submission, or the application will not be considered.
